messages.notif_running: Node running — messages deliver in the background
messages.error_generic: The operation could not be completed. No state was changed.
messages.error_startup: Komms could not start. Check the encrypted store and network settings, then try again.
messages.error_node_stopped: Komms is locked or stopped. Unlock and try again.
messages.error_folder: The folder could not be changed. Nothing else was changed.
messages.error_label: The label could not be changed. Nothing else was changed.
messages.error_pin: The pin could not be changed. Nothing else was changed.
messages.error_input: Check the entered information and try again.
messages.error_settings: The settings could not be saved. The previous settings remain active.
messages.ios_camera_usage: Komms uses the camera only to scan a contact’s pairing QR code or a safety-number QR during verification.
messages.ios_local_network_usage: Komms uses the local network to discover nearby peers for LAN-only delivery without requiring the internet.
messages.ios_microphone_usage: Komms uses the microphone only while you explicitly record an audio message or place or answer an authenticated live audio call.
messages.gate_tagline: Your identity and conversations stay encrypted on this device. No central account required.
messages.gate_passphrase_create_help: Choose a passphrase for the encrypted store on this device.
messages.gate_passphrase_unlock_help: Unlock your encrypted store on this device.
messages.gate_legacy_backup: This is a legacy KKR1–KKR7 copied-root backup
messages.gate_legacy_warning: The former address cannot safely resume. Komms will require a fresh identity, preserve only a clearly marked local archive and petnames, clear routes and trust, and require every contact to compare a new safety number.
messages.gate_starting_message: Opening your encrypted store and starting the node can take up to 30 seconds. Keep Komms open while this finishes.
messages.recovery_authority_required_body: This step is required before messaging. Anyone holding both this encrypted file and its 24 words can take over your stable identity and revoke every current device. Save the file on offline or removable storage, separate from the words.
messages.recovery_authority_retry_body: The offline authority was not saved: %1$s\n\nChoose an offline or removable location and try again. This profile cannot continue until both parts are saved.
messages.recovery_authority_interrupted: The first-run authority handoff was interrupted. This profile stays blocked because Komms cannot prove that both recovery parts were saved. Try the export once; if it is no longer available, use the guided new-identity reset when offered.
messages.recovery_authority_done_title: Offline authority written — phrase shown once
messages.recovery_authority_done_body: Write these 24 words down separately from the .kra file. Anyone with both parts controls this identity.\n\n%1$s

messages.discovery_dht_local_only: no bootstrap configured — LAN and shared delivery hints only
messages.authority_reset_archive_summary: %1$s\n%2$d pairwise rows and %3$d notes were copied locally. They are not newly authenticated history of this account.\n%4$d active groups and %5$d group-message rows were not transferred. %6$d contact(s) still require a new safety-number comparison.
messages.main_empty_detail: Pair with someone you trust, or keep a private note on this device.
messages.contact_rename_private_note: This petname stays sealed on this device. It is never sent to the contact and never identifies a recipient.

contact_warning_duplicate.one: %1$d other contact already has this exact private petname.
contact_warning_duplicate.other: %1$d other contacts already have this exact private petname.

messages.contact_warning_confusable: This name mixes lookalike scripts or resembles another local petname.
messages.contact_warning_bidi: This name contains directional controls that can change display order.
messages.contact_warning_invisible: This name contains invisible formatting characters.
messages.contact_warning_identity: Store “%1$s” anyway? Duplicate names remain separate by peer identity.
messages.main_groups_empty: No groups yet. Create one from stored contacts.
messages.message_requests_intro: People you have not accepted stay separate from contacts and conversation history. Review the preview and safety number before deciding.
messages.message_request_block_explanation: Blocking removes this sender’s local capabilities and queues. It cannot delete remote copies.
messages.group_invitation_explanation: Joining creates group state only after you accept. Earlier group history is not imported.
messages.my_qr_caption: Share this Connect QR or code for ordinary first contact:\n%1$s
messages.my_qr_frame: Pairing frame %1$d of %2$d · keep the scanner pointed here
messages.my_pairing_qr_caption: Scan this only during an immediate device-to-device pairing ceremony.
messages.rotate_connect_code_warning: Old Connect codes will stop finding you after their bounded records expire. Your identity, safety numbers, contacts, and history do not change.
messages.retire_legacy_discovery_warning: This permanently stops mailbox-only lookup under your stable Alpha address. It does not change identity or delete remote copies.
messages.key_changed_body: A new encryption session was established with %1$s. If they did not just reinstall or restore, verify safety numbers before trusting new messages.
messages.rendezvous_conflict: Conflicting authenticated route records were detected. No route was selected; retry later or verify this contact through another channel.
messages.wake_conflict: Conflicting authenticated wake state was detected. Native wake was disabled for this device; ordinary delivery remains available.
messages.backup_done_body: Write these 24 backup words down. They are shown once and stored nowhere. This root-free backup excludes live sessions, device keys, rendezvous secrets, and the offline account authority; recovery also requires the separately held .kra file and its different phrase.\n\n%1$s
messages.labels_empty: No labels. Create one to organize conversations locally.
messages.labels_empty_assignment: No labels exist. Open Manage labels from the conversation list first.
messages.label_delete_review: Delete %1$s? This atomically removes %2$d conversation assignments. Review before continuing.
messages.label_invalid_name: Use 1–256 UTF-8 bytes and at least one character outside the fixed Pattern White Space set.
messages.label_assignment_result: %1$s for %2$s is now %3$s. Final membership: %4$d labels.
messages.label_stale_help: These sealed local rows no longer resolve to both a label and an available conversation.
messages.label_stale_cleanup_description: Remove exactly this stale %1$s label membership

messages.add_hints_label: Delivery hints, one per line (optional):\nmultiaddr /ip4/…  ·  relay /ip4/…/p2p/…  ·  spool /path  ·  mesh broadcast
messages.call_start_description: Start an authenticated direct QUIC audio call
messages.call_direct_quic_note: Live audio uses an authenticated, end-to-end encrypted direct QUIC connection and is never stored in message history.
messages.call_offline: Calling unavailable: contact is offline or no direct route is known
messages.call_bulk_only: Calling unavailable: the current route is not real-time
messages.call_mesh_only: Calling unavailable: mesh routes do not carry live calls
messages.call_missing_session: Send a message first to establish an authenticated session before calling
messages.call_unsupported: This contact does not advertise compatible calling support
messages.call_already_active: Another call is already in progress
messages.call_answered_elsewhere: Call answered on another linked device
messages.call_audio_focus_failed: Another app is using audio; the call was ended
messages.call_microphone_denied: Microphone permission is required to place or answer a live call
messages.attachment_read_failed: The selected document could not be opened.
messages.attachment_export_open_failed: The export destination could not be opened.
messages.attachment_too_large: This attachment exceeds the 512 MiB limit.
messages.attachment_missing_primary: This attachment has no primary object to export.
messages.attachment_preview_failed: This image could not be safely previewed
messages.attachment_background_policy: Transfers continue through the foreground service when Komms is backgrounded; verified progress survives process restart.
messages.attachment_reveal_once_confirmation: Komms records consumption and removes the local message and media before showing the file. Other devices and applications may retain copies.
messages.attachment_view_once_safety: Sender-provided name and type. Not scanned. Opening is terminal here; other devices may retain copies.
messages.attachment_open_confirmation: Open “%1$s” with another application? The sender-provided file was not scanned for malware.
messages.attachment_open_failed: No application could open this file.
messages.attachment_export_only: This file can only be exported because its name or type is unknown, mismatched, or potentially active.
messages.attachment_safety_notice: Sender-provided name and type. Not scanned for malware; completed files never open automatically.
messages.attachment_warning_mismatch: The filename extension and claimed media type disagree.
messages.attachment_warning_dangerous: This name or type can contain executable or active content.
messages.attachment_warning_unrecognized: Komms does not recognize this file type.
messages.attachment_warning_missing_name: No filename was supplied, so its extension cannot be checked.
messages.scheduled_need_future: Choose a time in the future.
messages.scheduled_absolute_hint: Shown in local time; stored as an absolute UTC instant.
messages.state_held: held — will send when a faster link exists
messages.ephemeral_honesty: Removed from this device at the selected time; recipients and other devices may retain copies.
messages.ephemeral_view_once_honesty: Opening is terminal on this installation. The item is removed here before it is shown; recipients, other devices, screenshots, and external applications may retain copies.
messages.hints_help: One per line: multiaddr /ip4/… · relay /ip4/…/p2p/… · spool /path · mesh broadcast. Saving replaces the current hints.
messages.audio_stop_description: Stop recording and review the audio message
messages.audio_recording: Recording audio. Stop to review; it is not sent yet.
messages.audio_record_failed: Audio recording failed and was discarded.
messages.audio_focus_failed: Another app is using audio; recording did not start.
messages.audio_limit_reached: The 60 second limit was reached. Recording stopped for review.
messages.audio_review_ready: Recording stopped. Review it before explicitly sending or discarding.
messages.audio_interrupted_discarded: Recording stopped and was discarded when Komms left the foreground.
messages.audio_play_description: Play or pause this audio message; playback never starts automatically
messages.audio_permission_denied: Microphone permission was denied. The message composer remains usable.
messages.audio_permission_settings: Microphone access is disabled for Komms. Enable it in system settings to record audio messages.
messages.audio_locked: Komms locked; discard this recording and unlock again.
messages.audio_carrier_changed: Carrier state changed. Review the updated explanation, then choose Send audio again.
messages.group_no_contacts: Add at least one contact before creating a group.
messages.group_security_upgrade_required: Group security upgrade required. New messages and author-sensitive actions stay blocked until every current device receives a fresh recipient-specific origin capability.
messages.group_security_upgrading: Upgrading group security. %1$d device(s) are still waiting; Komms will continue automatically.
messages.group_security_authenticated_with_legacy: New messages are recipient-authenticated. %1$d older message(s) remain labelled as legacy membership-authenticated history.
messages.group_owner_must_transfer: Transfer ownership before leaving this group.
messages.group_remove_warning: Remove %1$s? Group keys rotate immediately for everyone who remains.
messages.group_leave_warning: Leave %1$s? Its message history stays stored on this device.
messages.group_no_longer_active: This group is no longer active. Its history remains stored.
messages.poll_visibility_policy: Votes are visible to every member. This is not anonymous. The current roster is fixed as the electorate, and only the poll creator can close it with a final vote snapshot.
messages.poll_open_policy: Open · single choice · votes visible to all members · not anonymous
messages.poll_closed_policy: Closed · final creator snapshot · votes visible to all members
messages.poll_moderated_policy: Closed by owner %1$s · signed moderation snapshot · votes visible to all members
messages.poll_moderate_confirm: Close “%1$s” through signed group authority? The owner sequences the exact final snapshot.
messages.poll_vote_confirm: Choose “%1$s”? Your identity and choice are visible to group members. You can change it until the poll closes.
messages.poll_close_confirm: Close “%1$s” with the visible vote heads shown now? This cannot be undone.
messages.poll_created: Visible-vote poll created for the current roster.
messages.poll_voted: Vote recorded. Votes are visible to group members.
messages.poll_closed: Poll closed with a final visible-vote snapshot.
messages.poll_need_choices: Enter at least two non-empty choices.
messages.poll_question_too_long: The poll question is longer than 1,024 UTF-8 bytes.
messages.poll_choice_too_long: Each poll choice must be at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.
messages.mention_member_description: Choose an exact current group member to mention
messages.mention_ready: All current members support semantic mentions. Review the exact final text before Send.
messages.mention_unavailable: Semantic mentions are unavailable for: %1$s. Send can use plain text with no mention notification.
messages.mention_plain_message: The exact visible text will be sent without semantic mentions and will trigger no mention notification.
messages.mention_review_again: The roster, identity mapping, or capability support changed. Review the exact text and selected mentions, then press Send again.
messages.mention_inserted: Mention of %1$s inserted. Review the exact final text.
messages.mention_removed: Mention of %1$s was removed because its text changed.
messages.mention_notification_private: You were mentioned in a group.
messages.mention_notification_preview: Open Komms to view a private update.
messages.mention_invalid_range: A mention range is no longer on an exact Unicode boundary. Choose the member again.
messages.verify_explain: Compare with the same screen on their device — read the digits aloud or scan each other's QR. Identical means nobody sits between you.
messages.verify_mismatch: CODES DO NOT MATCH — someone may be intercepting. Do not mark verified.
messages.settings_backup_summary: Export a root-free copy of identity, contacts, and history; restore also needs the separate offline authority
messages.settings_backup_accessibility: Root-free encrypted backup. Export identity, contacts, and history; restore also requires the separately held offline authority
messages.settings_devices_summary: Link, sync, rename, or revoke installations
messages.settings_devices_accessibility: Linked devices. Link, sync, rename, or revoke installations
messages.settings_icons_summary: Choose icons stored only on this device
messages.settings_folders_accessibility: Manage folders. Create and arrange private folders
messages.settings_labels_accessibility: Manage labels. Organize conversations with private labels
messages.settings_icons_accessibility: Manage private icons. Choose icons stored only on this device
messages.settings_advanced_note: Most people never need to change the provider or transport details. Optional defaults are signed, replaceable, and never required for core messaging routes.
messages.icons_privacy: Icons stay sealed on this device. Selected JPEG/PNG files are cropped, resized, and re-encoded without metadata. Icons are never fetched from URLs or sent to peers.
messages.theme_note: System follows Android live. The choice is private, sealed locally, and restored from encrypted backups. Color is never the only security or delivery cue.
messages.native_wake_android_limits: Wake is optional and carries no sender, message, conversation, unread count, or timestamp. Android may delay it in Doze, after force-stop, under OEM restrictions, or after provider deprioritization. It never changes sent or delivered state; mailbox and direct retry remain authoritative.
messages.native_wake_google_free: This Google-free build contains no FCM SDK and advertises no native-wake capability. Direct, mailbox, LAN, mesh, and file fallbacks remain available.
messages.settings_note: Same knobs as kultd's flags; stored without secrets in settings.json. Applied when the node next starts (lock, then unlock).
messages.set_mode_standard_disclosure: Standard can contact disclosed, replaceable providers. Those operators can observe your network address, timing, and service requests, but not message contents or your contact list.
messages.set_mode_private_disclosure: Private sends optional rendezvous requests through your local Tor proxy. Bootstrap and mailbox operators can still observe their own connections, and this mode does not claim non-collusion between providers.
messages.set_mode_sovereign_disclosure: Sovereign disables directory defaults and optional rendezvous or wake. DHT, user-selected mailboxes, direct, LAN, mesh, QR/file, and sneakernet routes remain available.
messages.set_standard_disclosure: I reviewed the Standard provider disclosure
messages.set_sovereign_direct_routes: Publish direct routes in Sovereign mode after accepting the reachability warning
messages.set_standard_confirmation_required: Review and confirm the Standard provider disclosure before using a signed provider directory.
messages.set_private_tor_required: Private optional providers require an explicit loopback Tor SOCKS5 endpoint.
messages.set_provider_roots: Trusted offline directory keys, lowercase hex (one per line)
messages.set_rendezvous_invalid: Rendezvous line %1$d must be https://host, 64 lowercase hex characters, and standard, private, or both.
messages.set_wake: Manual native-wake gateways (one per line; separate service keys)
messages.set_wake_invalid: Wake-gateway line %1$d must be https://host, 64 lowercase hex characters, and standard, private, or both.
messages.set_mesh_tcp: Meshtastic radio, network API host:4403 (optional; needs a meshtastic build)
messages.set_bridge: Bridge mesh↔internet when a radio is attached
messages.folders_empty: No folders yet. All conversations remain available in All and Unfiled.
messages.folder_create_description: Create a private local conversation folder
messages.folder_invalid_name: Use 1 to 256 UTF-8 bytes and include a character outside fixed Pattern White Space.
messages.folder_updated: Updated %1$s without changing membership or order
messages.folder_delete_review: Delete %1$s? %2$d conversation assignments will be removed atomically and become Unfiled. Conversations and messages are unchanged.
messages.folder_deleted: Folder deleted; %1$d assignments are now Unfiled.
messages.folder_stale_help: These sealed records no longer resolve to both a folder and an available conversation. Cleanup removes only the selected record.
messages.folder_stale_cleanup_description: Remove only the selected stale %1$s folder assignment
messages.folder_filter_description: Show %1$s, then apply the independent label filter
messages.folder_selection_unavailable: The protected selected folder is unavailable. Showing All conversations.
messages.message_edit_explanation: Saving creates a new authenticated edit event. The original and prior versions remain in this conversation.
